build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with two balls and jars using define_task_template decorator
add_dynamic_balls: create dynamic ball bodies in the PHYRE scene with configurable x and y positions
add_dynamic_jars: add dynamic jar bodies under balls in the PHYRE physics scene
update_task_relationships: set the task goal requiring two bodies to be touching using update_task
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to TWO_BALLS using set_meta
